source_refs.note: Topic 7.2.3 with the Did You Know (PDF 180-181, printed 177-178). The 90% figure is the book's claim.

blocks.text: Spam is mostly a nuisance, but spyware can cause serious privacy problems by stealing personal data, cookies can invade privacy by tracking activity, and phishing and pharming can cause financial loss and give criminals access to accounts. Over 90% of phishing attacks arrive by email, so always verify the source before clicking links or sharing details (Did You Know).
